semantics.reset: active-high synchronous; q becomes 5'b00001 on each rising edge with reset high
semantics.transition: With reset low, shift right and XOR outgoing q[0] into one-based tap positions 5 and 3: next[4]=q[0], next[3]=q[4], next[2]=q[3]^q[0], next[1]=q[2], next[0]=q[1].
semantics.between_edges: q holds; reset changes alone do not update q
semantics.initialization: No power-up initialization specified; no DUT initializer. Tests establish state by synchronous reset.
semantics.source: problem.txt Galois right-shift description, taps 5 and 3, and reset/clock paragraph

numeric.period: 31 nonzero states after reset before repeat
numeric.arithmetic: bitwise XOR only; no rounding, saturation or added latency

verification.oracle: Original problem interpreted as unsigned right shift XOR mask 20 if old LSB is 1; use integer arithmetic independent of DUT bit concatenation
verification.sampling: Inputs change on falling edge; compare after rising edge NBA settles and between rising edges
coverage: full 31-state unique nonzero cycle and return to seed
reset pulse entirely between rising edges
verification.failure: $fatal for mismatches, bounded timeout, PASS line only on completion

specification_ambiguities.resolution: Positions 5 and 3 are one-based register positions, mapping to zero-based q[4] and q[2]; position 5 cannot be a zero-based index of a 5-bit state.
Unspecified; no defined numeric state required before first sampled reset.
